lines.zh: 雷声一响，我的鳍就自己张开了。
lines.en: At the first thunder, my fins open on their own.

lines.zh: 我在深水里走，水压替我按着骨头。
lines.en: I walk in deep water; the pressure holds my bones.

lines.zh: 浪把我推来推去，我顺着走。
lines.en: The waves shove me about, and I go along.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴扫过海沟，翻起一层泥。
lines.en: My tail sweeps the trench and lifts a layer of silt.

lines.zh: 只有下雨打雷，海面才让我上来。
lines.en: Only in thunder and rain does the surface let me rise.

lines.zh: 我走得很慢，但海流会替我加速。
lines.en: I move slowly, but the current speeds me up.

lines.zh: 水里的鱼先跑，然后我才到。
lines.en: The fish flee first, and then I arrive.

lines.zh: 我踩过的海底会留下一串坑。
lines.en: The seabed I walk leaves a row of pits.

lines.zh: 光线到不了这里，我正好自在。
lines.en: Light never reaches this depth, which suits me.

lines.zh: 我沿着暴雨落下的位置游。
lines.en: I swim along the places where the rainstorm falls.

lines.zh: 上面的雷在敲，我在下面数。
lines.en: Thunder knocks above; I count the beats below.

lines.zh: 我的肚子贴着海床，像一块沉石。
lines.en: My belly drags on the seabed like a sunken stone.

lines.zh: 咸水灌进我的鳃，我不介意。
lines.en: Salt water floods my gills, and I do not mind.

lines.zh: 我不追光，我追浪底下的动静。
lines.en: I do not chase light; I chase noise under the waves.

lines.zh: 闪电照亮海床，我看清了路。
lines.en: Lightning lights the seabed and shows me the way.

lines.zh: 我在暗礁之间穿过去。
lines.en: I thread my way between sunken rocks.

lines.zh: 雨点砸在海面，声音传得很深。
lines.en: Rain hammers the surface and the sound sinks deep.

lines.zh: 我把胸鳍张开，稳住身子。
lines.en: I spread my pectoral fins to steady myself.

lines.zh: 我停在水里，等下一声雷。
lines.en: I hang in the water, waiting for the next thunder.

lines.zh: 我的肚子里还留着几条热带鱼。
lines.en: A few tropical fish are still inside my belly.

lines.zh: 没有雷雨，我就不该在这儿。
lines.en: Without a storm, I have no business being here.

lines.zh: 我张开嘴，让海流穿过去。
lines.en: I open my mouth and let the current pass through.

lines.zh: 海底很安静，安静得让我想咬东西。
lines.en: The seabed is quiet, quiet enough to make me want to bite.

lines.zh: 我在等浪把我推到浅一点的地方。
lines.en: I wait for the waves to push me somewhere shallower.

lines.zh: 我不叫，海已经够吵了。
lines.en: I do not call out; the sea is loud enough.

lines.zh: 我的鳞片上全是盐，碰一下会扎手。
lines.en: My scales are crusted with salt and prick the hand.

lines.zh: 头顶有船的声音，我抬头听了听。
lines.en: There is a boat above; I tilt my head and listen.

lines.zh: 我喘气很慢，一分钟才几下。
lines.en: I breathe slowly, only a few times a minute.

lines.zh: 这片海沟是我的，别的都是过路。
lines.en: This trench is mine; everything else is passing through.

lines.zh: 我把鱼骨吐在石缝里，堆了一小堆。
lines.en: I spit fish bones into a crevice, a small pile.

lines.zh: 天晴的时候我会沉得更深。
lines.en: On clear days I sink considerably deeper.

lines.zh: 我等的那声雷，总是来得比我想的晚。
lines.en: The thunder I wait for always comes later than I expect.

lines.zh: 你趴在船边看水，我正往上看。
lines.en: You lean over the boat looking down; I look up.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛长在头顶，专看水面。
lines.en: My eyes sit on my head, made for the surface.

lines.zh: 你的影子落进水里，我先看见它。
lines.en: Your shadow falls into the water, and I see it first.

lines.zh: 我盯你，是因为你在雷雨里站着。
lines.en: I stare because you are standing out in the storm.

lines.zh: 我的瞳孔是竖的，像两条裂缝。
lines.en: My pupils are upright slits, like two narrow cracks.

lines.zh: 你看见我的时候，我已经看了你很久。
lines.en: By the time you see me, I have watched you long.

lines.zh: 我眼睛不眨，海水替我洗。
lines.en: I do not blink; the seawater rinses my eyes.

lines.zh: 雷一闪，我们的目光就撞上了。
lines.en: Lightning flashes, and our gazes collide.

lines.zh: 你抬手挡雨，我从指缝里看你。
lines.en: You raise a hand against rain; I watch through it.

lines.zh: 别在雷雨天俯身看海，我会记住你的脸。
lines.en: Do not lean over the sea in a storm; I memorize faces.

lines.zh: 这一下打在我鳃上，我呛了口海水。
lines.en: That blow landed on my gills and I choked on seawater.

lines.zh: 我的血是暗的，混在水里看不清。
lines.en: My blood is dark and hard to see in the water.

lines.zh: 鳞片掉了两片，底下是灰白的肉。
lines.en: Two scales came off, showing grey flesh beneath.

lines.zh: 你打断了我的鳍，我游得歪了。
lines.en: You broke my fin, and now I swim crooked.

lines.zh: 疼让我更想吃东西，压不住。
lines.en: Pain only makes me hungrier, and I cannot hold it.

lines.zh: 我往下坠了半尺，又撑住了。
lines.en: I drop half a foot, then catch myself again.

lines.zh: 你的刀卡在我肩上了，拔不出来。
lines.en: Your blade is stuck in my shoulder and will not come out.

lines.zh: 我听见自己的骨头在响。
lines.en: I hear my own bones creaking under the strain.

lines.zh: 这一下没杀死我，你该后悔。
lines.en: That did not kill me, and you will regret it.

lines.zh: 我的伤口在咸水里烧得厉害。
lines.en: My wound burns fiercely in the salt water.

lines.zh: 你手里的热带鱼，隔着水我都闻得到。
lines.en: I can smell the tropical fish in your hand through water.

lines.zh: 我肚子里那几条，是前几天吃的。
lines.en: The few inside me were eaten a few days ago.

lines.zh: 把鱼扔远点，别扔在我正上方。
lines.en: Throw the fish farther away, not straight above me.

lines.zh: 我追鱼，也会顺便追拿鱼的人。
lines.en: I chase fish, and I also chase whoever holds them.

lines.zh: 你晃那条鱼的样子太像诱饵了。
lines.en: The way you swing that fish looks exactly like bait.

lines.zh: 我不挑食，只要能吞下去。
lines.en: I am not picky; anything I can swallow will do.

lines.zh: 鱼腥味会让我浮上来，你最好走开。
lines.en: The smell of fish pulls me up; you should step back.

lines.zh: 你喂我一次，我就记住这个位置。
lines.en: Feed me once and I will remember this spot.

lines.zh: 我吃鱼不嚼，整条滑进肚子。
lines.en: I do not chew fish; whole ones slide down.

lines.zh: 想用鱼换命，这买卖我不亏。
lines.en: Trading fish for your life is a good deal for me.

lines.zh: 你撞上来，像撞上一堵湿石头。
lines.en: You hit me like a wall of wet stone.

lines.zh: 我的皮又厚又凉，还带黏液。
lines.en: My hide is thick, cold, and covered in slime.

lines.zh: 蹭到我鳞片的地方会留一道红。
lines.en: Where you brush my scales, a red line stays.

lines.zh: 我被你顶得后退，但只退一点。
lines.en: Your shove pushes me back, but only a little.

lines.zh: 别靠太近，我的鳍有倒刺。
lines.en: Do not come so close; my fins carry barbs.

lines.zh: 水被我们挤开，发出闷响。
lines.en: The water is squeezed between us with a dull thud.

lines.zh: 我身上很滑，你抓不住我。
lines.en: I am slippery, and you cannot get a grip.

lines.zh: 你撞我的时候，我闻到了你的血。
lines.en: When you collided with me, I smelled your blood.

lines.zh: 我这具身体很沉，撞一下你自己会晕。
lines.en: This body is heavy; ramming it will daze you.

lines.zh: 碰到我就退，别等我张嘴。
lines.en: Touch me and back off, before I open my mouth.

lines.zh: 雷雨里成对的不多，我算一个例外。
lines.en: Few pair up in a thunderstorm; I am an exception.

lines.zh: 我们在海沟里贴在一起，雷替我们数拍。
lines.en: We press together in the trench while thunder keeps time.

lines.zh: 配偶会守着卵，我守得更凶。
lines.en: A mate guards the eggs; I guard them more fiercely.

lines.zh: 你靠近我们两个，会同时被盯上。
lines.en: Approach the two of us and we both mark you.

lines.zh: 我找到伴的时候，海面正好打雷。
lines.en: When I found my mate, thunder broke over the sea.

lines.zh: 她的鳞比我的亮，在深水里也看得见。
lines.en: Her scales shine brighter than mine, even down deep.

lines.zh: 我们不唱，我们用尾巴敲石头。
lines.en: We do not sing; we tap the stones with our tails.

lines.zh: 成对之后，我游得慢一些。
lines.en: After pairing, I swim a little more slowly.

lines.zh: 卵埋在沙下，别去挖。
lines.en: The eggs are buried under sand; do not dig there.

lines.zh: 你带走一个，另一个会追到岸上。
lines.en: Take one of us and the other follows to shore.

lines.zh: 我捡不动东西，我的鳍只会划水。
lines.en: I cannot pick things up; my fins only push water.

lines.zh: 沉到海底的箱子，我只会撞开。
lines.en: Chests sunk to the seabed, I only batter open.

lines.zh: 你掉的那把刀，沉下去我也懒得看。
lines.en: The knife you dropped sank; I cannot be bothered.

lines.zh: 我嘴里只放得下鱼。
lines.en: Only fish fit inside my mouth.

lines.zh: 铁器咬了会硌牙，我不碰。
lines.en: Iron hurts my teeth, so I leave it alone.

lines.zh: 我推了推那块沉木，它滚了两圈。
lines.en: I nudged the sunken log and it rolled twice.

lines.zh: 东西沉下来，最后都归海。
lines.en: Whatever sinks ends up belonging to the sea.

lines.zh: 你的东西我搬到石缝里了，别谢我。
lines.en: I moved your things into a crevice; no thanks needed.

lines.zh: 我不收藏，我只会吞。
lines.en: I do not collect things; I only swallow them.

lines.zh: 想让海底的东西回来，自己下来拿。
lines.en: Want your things back? Come down and get them.

lines.zh: 雷落下来的那一下，我选中了船上的人。
lines.en: The instant lightning struck, I chose someone on the boat.

lines.zh: 你在甲板上站着，太显眼了。
lines.en: You stood on the deck, far too easy to see.

lines.zh: 血腥味顺着雨水流进海里，我顺着找。
lines.en: Blood runs into the sea with the rain, and I follow it.

lines.zh: 我从下面看你的船，像看一块浮木。
lines.en: I see your boat from below, like a piece of driftwood.

lines.zh: 你下水了，那就省了我的事。
lines.en: You came into the water; that saves me trouble.

lines.zh: 我锁定你，是因为你在动。
lines.en: I lock onto you because you keep moving.

lines.zh: 浪把你推向我，我就顺手接了。
lines.en: The wave pushed you toward me, and I took it.

lines.zh: 你听见船底被撞了一下，那是我。
lines.en: You heard something hit the hull; that was me.

lines.zh: 我不追整船人，我只追落水的那一个。
lines.en: I do not chase the crew, only the one who fell in.

lines.zh: 目标一旦定了，雷停了我也不放。
lines.en: Once the target is set, the storm ending changes nothing.

lines.zh: 我绕你的船底，一圈比一圈紧。
lines.en: I circle beneath your hull, tighter with each lap.

lines.zh: 你的影子在水里晃，我跟着晃。
lines.en: Your shadow sways in the water, and I sway along.

lines.zh: 我在等你换气，人总要换气的。
lines.en: I wait for you to surface; everyone must breathe.

lines.zh: 海流替我推着，我几乎不用动。
lines.en: The current carries me; I hardly have to move.

lines.zh: 你越是往礁石那边游，我越高兴。
lines.en: The more you swim toward the reef, the happier I am.

lines.zh: 我能听见你在水里咬牙。
lines.en: I can hear your teeth grinding underwater.

lines.zh: 别停下，停下我就咬腿。
lines.en: Do not stop; if you stop I go for the legs.

lines.zh: 你抓着船桨，我咬着另一头。
lines.en: You grip the oar; I bite the other end.

lines.zh: 我把你往深水赶，那里我说了算。
lines.en: I herd you into deep water, where I decide things.

lines.zh: 雷再响两次，你就游不动了。
lines.en: Two more thunderclaps and you will not be able to swim.

lines.zh: 我的牙是往里弯的，咬住就不松。
lines.en: My teeth curve inward; once I bite, I do not let go.

lines.zh: 一口下去，海水立刻红了。
lines.en: One bite, and the seawater turns red at once.

lines.zh: 我咬的时候不发声，只有水响。
lines.en: I make no sound when biting, only the water does.

lines.zh: 你的腿在我嘴里，别乱踢。
lines.en: Your leg is in my mouth; stop kicking.

lines.zh: 我甩头，你就被撕开一道口。
lines.en: I shake my head and a gash opens on you.

lines.zh: 这一口是给上一条逃掉的鱼。
lines.en: This bite is for the fish that got away before.

lines.zh: 我伤人不为吃，为让你沉下来。
lines.en: I wound to make you sink, not to feed.

lines.zh: 你抓住我背鳍了，那可抓错了地方。
lines.en: You grabbed my dorsal fin; that was a mistake.

lines.zh: 血在水里散开，我马上会更兴奋。
lines.en: Blood spreads through the water, and I get eager.

lines.zh: 我一口就能把你从甲板拖下去。
lines.en: One bite can drag you off the deck.

lines.zh: 雷一响，海面开始冒泡，那就是我。
lines.en: When thunder sounds and the surface boils, that is me.

lines.zh: 我只在暴雨的海洋里浮上来。
lines.en: I only rise in the ocean during heavy storms.

lines.zh: 晴天的海没有我，你可以放心游。
lines.en: On clear days the sea has no me; swim freely.

lines.zh: 云压得越低，我浮得越高。
lines.en: The lower the clouds press, the higher I rise.

lines.zh: 我从海沟底往上，一层一层地起。
lines.en: I come up from the trench floor, layer by layer.

lines.zh: 闪电劈到海面，我就在那片光里出来。
lines.en: Lightning hits the sea, and I emerge in that light.

lines.zh: 雨点打在海上，把我从深处敲醒。
lines.en: Rain beats the sea and knocks me awake from below.

lines.zh: 你在雷雨天出海，就是来见我的。
lines.en: Sailing out in a thunderstorm is coming to meet me.

lines.zh: 风停之前，还会有好几个我上来。
lines.en: Before the wind dies, several more of me will rise.

lines.zh: 每次风暴，海沟里都会多一层鳞。
lines.en: Every storm leaves another layer of scales in the trench.

lines.zh: 火在水下烧不旺，只留下一层热。
lines.en: Fire cannot burn down here, only leave a layer of heat.

lines.zh: 我从水里被摔到石头上，闷响一声。
lines.en: I am thrown from the water onto rock with a dull thud.

lines.zh: 我本来就在水里，淹不死我。
lines.en: I already live in water; drowning cannot reach me.

lines.zh: 爆炸把水掀开，我被甩到浅滩。
lines.en: The blast lifts the water and throws me into shallows.

lines.zh: 箭扎进鳞片，只进了一寸。
lines.en: The arrow bites my scales but only an inch deep.

lines.zh: 绿雾渗进鳃里，我一阵发木。
lines.en: Green mist seeps into my gills and I go stiff.

lines.zh: 我饿了三天，连海草都咬。
lines.en: Three days hungry, and I bite even the seaweed.

lines.zh: 雷劈进海里，我全身都亮了。
lines.en: Lightning strikes the sea and my whole body lights up.

lines.zh: 虚空里没有海，我的鳃白张着。
lines.en: No sea in the void; my gills open on nothing.
